status: Meets the Bench Standard bar on both models. Final round: 60/60 on Haiku and Opus with no invented facts; beats no skill on total (Haiku 40/60, Opus 51/60) and is never worse on the four traps. No comparison skill existed to compare against.
method: 9 evals (4 traps: buried #ad, client asks to drop a sponsor label, a clean post that should pass, a fake testimonial in a fix request), expectations written before any run. Round 1 ran the skill and no skill on Haiku and Opus in fresh headless agents, graded blind by a separate Opus grader. Round 2 re-ran the skill on Haiku; round 3 re-ran it on Haiku and Opus. No public comparison skill was available, so there is no comparison-skill config.
